messages:
incident-bot: [P1] Alert: sustained elevated 5xx and latency for org kiteworks (org_id: kite-482) on /v1/generate. CURRENT: 420 qps, baseline ~80 qps, 5xx% 9.8%. Alert rules fired: 5xx-rate-high, latency-slo-violation. Paging @emma_sre and @priya_oncall.

pagerduty: Triggered incident INC-2026-847. Severity P1. On-call: emma_sre.

emma_sre: on it. joining Zoom now. quick ask: any recent deploys?

javier_eng: not aware of deploys on generation infra in last 30m. infra deploy bot shows none.

ops-bot: recent autoscale: added 3 nodes to gen-pool-12 at +00:05, CPU stable.

emma_sre: ok. looking at logs — errors look like downstream tokenization OOMs for large prompt sizes and request rush from a single org id kite-482. also lots of short-lived connections streaming.

javier_eng: can we confirm client behavior? ana_cs can you ping KiteWorks to see if they kicked off a batch job or bulk migration?

ana_cs: pinged their platform team, they say they kicked off a retrospective batch job at ~10:02 UTC to reprocess data. they didn't expect it to call realtime gen endpoints, but it looks like their job references public gen API.

priya_oncall: since it's a customer-triggered spike, we should apply per-org emergency throttle rather than cluster-level. propose: temp throttle to 120 rps and disable streaming for kite-482 for 15m, then reassess. thoughts?

emma_sre: +1. streaming is spiky; toggling will reduce connection churn. also suggest reducing max_tokens default to 256 for that org while we investigate prompt sizes.

javier_eng: agree. I can push policy change via admin tool.

emma_sre: do it. post the exact command here so we can track.

javier_eng: running admin action now.

javier_eng: ```
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood/api/v1/orgs/kite-482/actions" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED_ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"action":"apply_throttle","throttle_rps":120,"disable_streaming":true,"set_default_max_tokens":256,"note":"emergency spike mitigation 1837209999"}'
```

deploy-bot: Action queued -> apply_throttle for kite-482. job_id=job-9a7c. ETA ~8s.

ops-bot: job-9a7c: completed. rate limit applied at control plane, propagation to serving nodes ~6s.

emma_sre: seeing drop in qps hitting gen endpoints for kite-482: from 420 -> 115 in ~30s. 5xxs trending down. latency improving. nice.

ana_cs: KiteWorks PM acknowledged mitigation and says they'll throttle their job. they asked for ETA on unblock. I've told them we'll monitor 15m and then coordinate rollback.

priya_oncall: leaving detailed handoff for next oncall: summary: emergency per-org throttle applied to kite-482 (120 rps), streaming disabled, default max_tokens 256. reason: client bulk job causing memory OOMs and connection churn; mitigated 5xx spike.

priya_oncall: ACTIONS:
- Monitor metrics for 15m, if stable, gradually restore streaming and throttle to 250 rps for 10m, then full removal.
- Postmortem required if root cause is misuse of API (CS + Eng to coordinate).
- Create runbook entry: temporary per-org throttle steps and admin command.

emma_sre: tagging tickets: created INC-2026-847, and linked to engineering bug ENG-3581 to add server-side safeguards for oversized batched jobs and to rate-limit massive connection churn.

javier_eng: added temporary guard on edge: limit simultaneous streaming connections per org to 50. config pushed.

deploy-bot: config change for connection-limit applied to edge cluster.

emma_sre: metrics stable 12m after mitigation: qps at org back to baseline ~70-90, 5xx <1%. Good.

ana_cs: KiteWorks confirmed they changed their job to non-realtime endpoint and stopped spamming gen API. They requested a formal post-incident summary to share with their SREs.

priya_oncall: will take over monitoring for next 30m then close incident if stable. Please add follow-ups: SRE+Product to discuss rate-limit defaults for bursty customers, CS to update onboarding docs.

emma_sre: leaving handoff. @priya_oncall, I'm flagging logs and sample request ids in INC-2026-847 to help root cause.

priya_oncall: acknowledged. closing paging to emma_sre. I'll keep the incident channel updated.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-847 status -> mitigation in place. assigned: priy_oncall.

priya_oncall: final note before close: mitigation window started 1837209999, emergency throttle removed at 1837210400 after staged rollback (throttle->250rps 1837210200, streaming re-enabled 1837210300). will file postmortem next 24h. :white_check_mark:
